Python with comments, verify comment count

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ProcessConfig, process } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack";
function main() {
  const config: ProcessConfig = { comments: true, language: "python" };
  const result = process("# This is a comment\n# Another comment\ndef hello():\n    # inline comment\n    pass\n", config);
  console.log(result.language);
  console.log(result.comments);
}

void main();
```
